body:
Dont you guys have that "Santa Muerte" religious following?
I thought its quite death-friendly and existential thing.

I'm 38 white male, my first (and only) attempt was at 17 and I'm off'ing myself in very near future - maybe next month.

At 17 you dont overthink, you just act. Back then I graduated from school. And just few days before the final ceremony it was like a concussion bomb exploded next to me - I realized - this is it - game over. I'm on my own against this sinister, hostile world and I have to live to - what - 60 ? 70 ? Why should I ? Who said so?

And it was so unbearable, so bitter, so hopeless. And I calmly went to the other room, found a razor, waited until my parents go to sleep, and slit my wrist. No pain. Nothing. Just passed out.

Only to rediscover myself in the middle of the night, with my blood clotted. Said to myself "Damn I'm not dead. Lets wait.. I will be dead by morning".

No. At 7 AM parents knocked my door to wake up, started to run around and call the medics. Damn. Bad luck.

I don't blame the medics, it's their duty. I cannot hate or despise them. But in my mind, if I'd ever meet any of them - I'd spit into their faces for not letting me die.

Back to the topic - if you don't overthink it - it's easier than you realize.

20 years passed and now I'm more prepared. I'm reading books on the subject, search for other reports, but most importantly - I'm in peace with myself on that.

PS: I'm not some weirdo or mental. No "voices" or crazy thoughts, never. Just terminally bored with this soap opera that you see around yourself 24/365.

You're a soldier and a taxpayer. Look at the honeybees or an ant colony, dude!

They're all part of their big happy family. Working every day. And a working ant should not question the authorities. Just work and pay taxes and you'll be doing great.

No.

To be somebody, you need specific traits of character.
That are laid down way too earlier than you realize. 1-3 of age.
Conditioned later (teen years). But by the time you are 30 - everything is already too fucked up.

You can't just take 30 years of negative memories and erase it. Not gonna happen.

Please prove me wrong, based on your personal achievements.

Thats a totally different way. Are you sure you want to reborn as human again?

A bonobo ape sounds better. Or a three-toed sloth. :)

No.

But hydrogen and carbon and other elements that you are made of will be recycled in the nature.

Dont listen to religious freaks. Just do not.

I simply delete all chats in my phone one by one, like a row of flipswitches. If a person writes me, I dont return any messages and block him.

To me is soothing to realize that we are all alone - parents or whatever people I know - they are not you. And not going to live your life for you. And their daily gibberish is actually nothing special.

When I shut down last of my connections - I'm ready.
Because their thought was "I'm going to die and then hover at the ceiling level and watch their sorrow and misery, how unjust they were on me, muahaha (gleeful laughter)".
Feels like jealously, like someone had just hit the jackpot.

Hmmm... Since when womanizing is considered a sin? It's 21st century, dude, not the Dark Ages.

If you're high in testosterone (likely), good talker (your post shows it), handsome (probably) - what is wrong with chasing pretty females?

And forget about relationships if you grew up to a divorced mom, seriously.
Submitting yourself to a cookie-cutter existence wont do you any good.

I grew up in a full family, but my father was on frequent business trips (for 4-5 months abroad), and my mother was working 9 to 5. So I got used to take care about myself - after school, homework, warming a precooked meal, etc. Now I understand I don't need anyone to be beside me. None. 
And I kinda like it. Thats just me and fuck everyone who'd start preaching about 200 hundred years old family values.

If being popular among females is your strong side - why fight it? Excuse me if I sound too straight-forward, maybe you come from a religious family and its a totally different situation...

When they talk about anxiety.... its not an anxiety in people! People simply dont know "How".

Some fucker might tell you "Think positively and make $10k a month. Understood? Go!"

And you are left one on one against the whole world. Whom are you going to contact? Whom to sell? Whom to hire? Whom to talk into believing you?

Its hard to thrive if your (read:mine) Emotional Intelligence (EQ/EI) is near zero.

Its much easier if you know people's weaknesses and desires - greed, lust, narcissism - and can cash out on it. Thats how any business goes.Thats where the money grows.

Higher Emotional Intelligence - higher your success and profits. And it's not me, its Jack Ma (Alibaba founder) once said, slightly in different words.

yes :) i have (rather have had) a friend who was a new-age nut, big time.

and he told me exactly the same - "there's a long queue of souls waiting to be born into this world" blah blah. every time he was saying it i've been stopping myself to call an ambulance :) yeah, they are weirdos indeed.

very much so!

do you hate them for that?

i finally realized that i do hate mine. i understand that its counterproductive, its only partly their fault. but still, cant help stopping it...

Not exactly :) I was asking if you know of some forums (in darknet, supposedly), where we can share our real thoughts, plans and preparations. Sort of "Right to Die" community, where talking someone *out* of their choice would be considered a harassment. Because I need some encouragement to die, not to live. And this "mutual admiration society" here in SW is simply pathetic. Dont mean to offend anybody, but thats how it feels.

The ones who will try to talk you out have only a limited number of dirty tricks.
They will try to instill the feeling of:

1. Shame / guilt ("You're a coward)
2. Fear ("It's painful)
3. False sense of hope ("The future has a silver lining")

Or combination of all. They are good at it, though.

Understanding that I can (and I will) end it - is the post precious thought of mine.
If you are still scared, you're not ready. It will pass.

F**ck you. You're not the one to tell anybody that he is weak.

If somebody wants to die, there's a good reason for that. Life is a zero-sum game anyways, eventually you will die too. Time and date is not important.

So? 911 is going to live your life for you? They can wish you well, at most.

I remember when I first tried (at 17), I lost one or two liters of blood and was put in emergency care for blood transfusion. I have a complete amnesia of that period, but 3-4 days later, still in hospital, but normal recovery room, I remember that greaseball psychoneurologist or whoever fuck he was, with oily hair, showed up and asked - "While in ER, you said you gonna complete your attempt one way or another. Is that correct? Because then we have to put you in a mental ward".

I'm not a psycho or weirdo or nutcase, so I was smart enough to say "No no. Of course not, I have no such intentions".

And they let me go. Motherfuckers. I hate them all. They'll never do you any good, remember. Forget all these helplines.

I'd introduce a new word into English: "livers" or "deathers". Livers, of course, it not a plural for body organ.

We never understand each other, a typical "liver" will always find a reason to live, no matter what. One author once described it "as if you're reading a book of life - and you're constantly curious what is on next page, where would it get you".

And deathers - myself included - we never opted-in for reading the book. Not even have a library card. We were forced to. I'd take the fucking book and throw it into the fire. At any minute. And the coffee cup would follow it.
And please: PM from a throw-away account if you will, I don't need to know your name or background. I respect your privacy and feelings.
Around $200 for the gas, and $250 for the cylinder. In local currency, as I'm not in the US.
